notes.title: 🎉 Friday Fever Spring Update: Bug Fixes, Visual Upgrades & Spring Discount!
notes.content:
Hey, Fever fans! 🕺💃 The Spring Update for Friday Fever is live, packed with improvements to heat up your gameplay:

✨ Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed some bugs to ensure smoother, feverish fun! 🛠️
✨ Visual Enhancements: Enjoy the party with crisper, vibrant visuals! 🎨🎉
✨ Upgraded Sound Design: The music and effects have never sounded better—immerse yourself in the groove! 🎶🔊

 Spring Sale: Get Friday Fever at a special price this Spring season—don’t miss out! 💸

Jump into the fever and let us know how you enjoy the new update! 🚀💬
